answer: Anyone running 88 aliases therefore needs 126 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are published in lotus, expire in haven, and whisper lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1551 identities would post 1200 proofs and burn roughly 43 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
